title: Cooperative compact-LiDAR target tracking
description: Compact target estimates and visibility-aware control help UAVs maintain tracking when 3D LiDAR detections are sparse or intermittent.
introduction: A person can generate only a small number of returns in a compact 3D LiDAR scan. This work connects local detection, shared target estimates and predictive following motions so that robots can help one another maintain awareness.

problem.heading: Sparse observations can disappear between viewpoints.
paragraphs: At longer ranges, a person may contribute too few LiDAR returns for consistent detection. Missed observations create gaps in the local target estimate and make reliable following difficult.

Cooperation can provide complementary observations, but sensing and motion must work together. A UAV must follow the target while preserving visibility, avoiding obstacles and maintaining separation from its teammate.

approach.heading: Share estimates, then move to keep seeing.
paragraphs: Each UAV processes its compact LiDAR observations locally and maintains a target estimate using an unscented Kalman filter. Robots share target state estimates and covariance, rather than exchanging full point clouds.

A nonlinear model predictive controller uses these estimates to follow the target with line-of-sight constraints. This joins cooperative estimation with motion that seeks to preserve useful observations.

When one robot misses a detection, the shared estimate can incorporate information from its teammate. The complete two-UAV pipeline is demonstrated in simulation, while a separate outdoor experiment evaluates sensing and tracking on one UAV.

steps.title: Detect locally
steps.text: Process sparse compact-LiDAR observations on each UAV.

steps.title: Estimate and share
steps.text: Exchange target state and uncertainty between local filters.

steps.title: Follow with visibility
steps.text: Use predictive control to preserve line of sight and safe motion.

evidence.label: Complete cooperative pipeline
evidence.text: The two-UAV simulation runs local detection, cooperative target estimation and visibility-aware following together. This is the evidence for the complete cooperative pipeline.

evidence.label: Outdoor sensing and tracking
evidence.text: A separate single-UAV outdoor experiment supports the compact-LiDAR sensing and tracking components. It is not presented as a two-UAV cooperative hardware trial.

evidence.label: Observation uncertainty
evidence.text: The method shares both a target estimate and its uncertainty. Sparse detections motivate cooperation, while visibility constraints connect the quality of future observations to robot motion.
